description: This file defines the implementation of absl::node_hash_set, an optimized unordered associative container similar to std::unordered_set but with enhancements for speed, memory efficiency, and pointer stability. It includes class templates, member functions, and internal policies related to hash set operations.

classes.name: absl::node_hash_set
classes.description: A template class implementing an efficient, pointer-stable hash set container with support for heterogeneous lookup, rehashing, and other set operations.

methods.name: erase_if
methods.description: Template function to erase all elements satisfying a predicate from a node_hash_set.
